cards.name: TextFrameItem
cards.path: Scripting commands and classes for Adobe Illustrator/TextFrameItem
cards.summary: One text object in an Illustrator document: point text, area text (text flowed inside a shape) or type on a path. It holds the string (contents), gives access to its formatting through textRange / characters / words / lines / paragraphs, controls area-text rows and columns, path-text placement and threading to other frames, and can be converted to outlines.
use_for: poster or banner headline filled from data
batch-replacing copy in templates (names, prices, dates)
outlining a logo wordmark for print or vector handoff
multi-column area text for flyers and brochures
type on a circular badge or seal path
walking every text frame for a pre-press font / overset check
avoid: createOutline when the text must stay editable: the frame is replaced by a GroupItem; work on a copy or keep the .ai master
formatting long text character by character through characters: slow; set textRange (or a words / paragraphs range) in one go
rows and columns on point or path text: only area text has them; convertPointObjectToAreaObject first

equivalents.PS: Scripting commands and classes for Adobe Photoshop/TextItem

cards.how: ExtendScript: app.activeDocument.textFrames[i] (every text frame in the document), a layer's textFrames, or story.textFrames for the frames a threaded story runs through; new frames come from the TextFrameItems collection (pointText / areaText / pathText). Formatting sits one level down: textRange.characterAttributes and the characters / words / lines / paragraphs ranges. Position, size, name, opacity and the other geometry come from the PageItem superclass and are not listed on this class. COM: the TextFrame interface of the Illustrator type library.

key_members.name: contents
key_members.use: read / replace the whole string of the frame

key_members.name: kind
key_members.use: read-only TextType: POINTTEXT, AREATEXT or PATHTEXT; check before using area- or path-only members

key_members.name: textRange
key_members.use: the full text as a TextRange; the usual door to characterAttributes for whole-frame formatting

key_members.name: characters
key_members.use: per-character ranges (slow on long text)

key_members.name: words
key_members.use: per-word ranges, e.g. colour one word of a headline

key_members.name: paragraphs
key_members.use: per-paragraph ranges for paragraph formatting

key_members.name: lines
key_members.use: the composed lines, e.g. to count how many lines a headline broke into

key_members.name: story
key_members.use: the Story this frame belongs to (shared by threaded frames)

key_members.name: textPath
key_members.use: the path that holds area or path text (resize the box / edit the curve)

key_members.name: anchor
key_members.use: start of the baseline for point text

key_members.name: columnCount
key_members.use: area text: number of columns

key_members.name: rowCount
key_members.use: area text: number of rows

key_members.name: columnGutter
key_members.use: area text: space between columns

key_members.name: spacing
key_members.use: path text: spacing setting of type on a path

key_members.name: startTValue
key_members.use: path text: where the text starts along the path

key_members.name: nextFrame
key_members.use: the frame this one threads into (linked area text)

key_members.name: orientation
key_members.use: TextOrientation HORIZONTAL or VERTICAL

key_members.name: antialias
key_members.use: TextAntialias NONE / SHARP / CRISP / STRONG for raster output of the text

key_members.name: createOutline
key_members.use: convert the text to vector outlines; returns a GroupItem

key_members.name: convertPointObjectToAreaObject
key_members.use: turn point text into area text; returns the new TextFrameItem

gotchas: createOutline() returns a GroupItem and the text frame no longer exists afterwards; any variable still pointing at the frame is dead. Copy the frame first when an editable version is needed.

kind is read-only. Switch between point and area text with convertPointObjectToAreaObject / convertAreaObjectToPointObject and keep using their return value (whether the old reference stays valid is unverified).

Area-only members (rowCount, columnCount, rowGutter, columnGutter, flowLinksHorizontally, firstBaseline, firstBaselineMin) and path-only members (spacing, startTValue, endTValue) only mean something for that kind; what happens when they are set on the wrong kind (error or silently ignored) is unverified.
Assigning contents replaces the whole string; the new text takes the formatting of the first character (unverified), so restyle through textRange after assigning.
Paragraph breaks inside contents are carriage returns (\r); a \n written by a script may read back as \r (unverified).
Area text that does not fit is overset and this class has no overset flag; detect it by comparing the story's text with what the frame's lines hold (unverified approach) or enlarge the frame.
anchor is the baseline start for point text, not the top-left corner; to place a frame by its bounding box use the inherited PageItem position.
A font missing on this machine is substituted when the file opens; createOutline then outlines the substitute, so check fonts before outlining.
move and duplicate are declared in the 30.2 dictionary with two required parameters (relativeObject, insertionLocation).

cards.name: View
cards.path: Scripting commands and classes for Adobe Illustrator/View
cards.summary: The on-screen view of a document window: zoom factor, the point shown at the centre of the window, view rotation and screen mode. Changing it changes only what is displayed, never the artwork or any export.
use_for: zoom to 100 % or onto an artboard before a window capture or screen recording
centring the window on a logo for a review screenshot
resetting a rotated view before handing a file back
switching screen mode for a clean presentation capture
avoid: controlling export size or framing: views do not affect exportFile / imageCapture; use the Document export calls and artboards
headless or minimised runs: a view belongs to a document window, and the screen may not repaint until app.redraw() (behaviour with no visible window unverified)
cards.how: ExtendScript: app.activeDocument.activeView (the view of the current window) or app.activeDocument.views[i]. Set zoom / centerPoint / rotateAngle directly; screen mode through the screenMode property or setScreenMode(ScreenMode.X) with MULTIWINDOW, DESKTOP or FULLSCREEN. COM: the View interface.

key_members.name: zoom
key_members.use: zoom factor of the view (1 = 100 %)

key_members.name: visibleZoom
key_members.use: the zoom value the user sees in the UI

key_members.name: centerPoint
key_members.use: document point shown at the centre of the window; set it to pan

key_members.name: bounds
key_members.use: read-only rectangle of the area currently visible

key_members.name: rotateAngle
key_members.use: view rotation in degrees (Rotate View); artwork is not rotated

key_members.name: screenMode
key_members.use: current ScreenMode (MULTIWINDOW, DESKTOP, FULLSCREEN)

key_members.name: setScreenMode
key_members.use: switch screen mode; returns true on success

key_members.name: parent
key_members.use: the Document that owns the view

gotchas: zoom is a factor (1 = 100 %, 2 = 200 %), not a percentage.
visibleZoom can differ from zoom (for example on HiDPI displays or with a display-at-print-size preference) (unverified cause); use visibleZoom when matching the number in the zoom box.
bounds is read-only: frame an area by setting zoom and centerPoint, then read bounds back to check what is visible.
Whether centerPoint follows app.coordinateSystem or always uses document coordinates is unverified; read it back after setting.
rotateAngle only rotates the view; reset it to 0 before a window capture so the screenshot is upright (unverified whether windowCapture follows view rotation).

ScreenMode has three values (MULTIWINDOW, DESKTOP, FULLSCREEN) and the View > Screen Mode menu has three items (Normal Screen Mode, Full Screen with Menu Bar Mode, Full Screen Mode); pairing them in that order is likely but unverified, so read screenMode back after setting it.
View changes are not edits: they do not mark the document as modified and are not undo steps (unverified).

review.changes: screen-mode gotcha said the 3 ScreenMode values do not map onto the menu; the menu harvest has exactly 3 Screen Mode items, rewrote it as a likely 1:1 pairing (unverified); marked the no-visible-window claim unverified

cards.name: Application
cards.path: Suite that applies to all applications/Application
cards.summary: The running Illustrator itself and the root of every script: the open documents and the active one, the selection, installed fonts, presets, preferences and version info, plus app-level actions such as opening files, running menu commands and recorded actions, undo / redo, clipboard, transformation-matrix maths, workspaces and tool selection.
use_for: entry point of any Illustrator automation (batch export, template fill, pre-press check)
opening a batch of .ai / .pdf / .svg files
running a menu command that has no DOM call (executeMenuCommand), e.g. Type > Create Outlines
playing a recorded action on many files (doScript)
silencing alerts for unattended runs (userInteractionLevel)
listing installed fonts and PDF / print presets before an export
avoid: the aAT* sequencer members, runAPITest, the begin*AutomationTest calls, getHelloJSONData / getCCXUserJSONData (home screen), reflectCSAW (ActionScript wrapper generator) and openCloudLibraryAssetForEditing / setThumbnailOptionsForCloudLibrary (marked For Internal Use): internal hooks, not for production scripts
executeMenuCommand when a DOM call exists: it depends on the current selection and fails silently; prefer the DOM (e.g. TextFrameItem.createOutline)
quit() in a shared pipeline: it closes documents other processes may own

equivalents.PS: Suite that applies to all applications/Application

cards.how: ExtendScript: the global app object (app.activeDocument, app.documents, app.open(file)). From outside Illustrator: COM ProgID Illustrator.Application (the _Application interface), whose DoJavaScript / DoJavaScriptFile run ExtendScript; that is how a Python or PowerShell pipeline drives Illustrator.

key_members.name: activeDocument
key_members.use: the document in the front window (throws when none is open)

key_members.name: documents
key_members.use: all open documents; new documents are added through this collection

key_members.name: open
key_members.use: open a file (optionally forcing RGB / CMYK document colour space)

key_members.name: selection
key_members.use: what the user has selected in the active document

key_members.name: userInteractionLevel
key_members.use: DONTDISPLAYALERTS for unattended runs, DISPLAYALERTS to restore

key_members.name: coordinateSystem
key_members.use: ARTBOARDCOORDINATESYSTEM or DOCUMENTCOORDINATESYSTEM for every position the script reads or writes

key_members.name: executeMenuCommand
key_members.use: run a menu item by its command string (e.g. "outline" = Type > Create Outlines)

key_members.name: doScript
key_members.use: play an action from the Actions panel: doScript(action, from, dialogs), from = the set name; dialogs defaults to true

key_members.name: loadAction
key_members.use: load an .aia action set file before doScript

key_members.name: unloadAction
key_members.use: remove a loaded action set / action afterwards

key_members.name: redraw
key_members.use: force a screen refresh during a long script

key_members.name: undo
key_members.use: undo the last transaction

key_members.name: textFonts
key_members.use: installed fonts; getByName with a PostScript name gives a TextFont

key_members.name: preferences
key_members.use: Illustrator preferences object

key_members.name: version
key_members.use: application version string (this harvest was made on 30.2.1.1; the exact string returned is unverified)

key_members.name: PDFPresetsList
key_members.use: names of available PDF presets

key_members.name: getIsFileOpen
key_members.use: check whether a file path is already open before opening it

key_members.name: getRotationMatrix
key_members.use: build a rotation Matrix for a PageItem transform

key_members.name: concatenateScaleMatrix
key_members.use: add a scale to an existing Matrix; scaleX / scaleY are percentages (default 100)

key_members.name: quit
key_members.use: quit Illustrator

gotchas: app.activeDocument throws when no document is open; check app.documents.length first.
selection is normally an array of page items, but while text is being edited with the Type tool it is a TextRange (unverified for 30.2); check typename before looping.

userInteractionLevel = UserInteractionLevel.DONTDISPLAYALERTS suppresses most alerts, but some dialogs on open (missing fonts / links, plug-in dialogs) can still block an unattended run (unverified); restore DISPLAYALERTS at the end.
coordinateSystem changes the meaning of every position and bounds value; set it explicitly at the top of the script instead of trusting the default (default value unverified).
executeMenuCommand takes the internal command string ("selectall", "outline"), not the menu label; a wrong string or an empty selection does nothing and raises no error.

doScript needs the action and set names exactly as in the Actions panel and the set must already be loaded (loadAction); its third argument dialogs defaults to true, so pass false in an unattended run or the action's dialogs can open.

The matrix helpers (getRotationMatrix, getScaleMatrix, concatenate*Matrix, invertMatrix) return new Matrix objects and change nothing until the matrix is applied to an item; getScaleMatrix / concatenateScaleMatrix take percentages (default 100), not factors.
Without redraw() the window only updates when the script ends.
COM member names are capitalised (ActiveDocument, DoJavaScript); ExtendScript uses lowerCamelCase.

review.changes: version note said 30.2, batch is 30.2.1.1; doScript dialogs argument defaults to true (added to member and gotcha); scale-matrix args are percentages default 100; internal-hooks list corrected (reflectCSAW is a wrapper generator, added the two For Internal Use cloud-library calls)

cards.name: Document
cards.path: Suite that applies to all applications/Document
cards.summary: An open Illustrator file: every artwork collection (layers, pageItems, pathItems, textFrames, groupItems, placed / raster / symbol items), artboards, swatches, gradients, patterns, styles, variables and datasets, plus the calls that save, export, print, rasterize, capture and close it.
use_for: batch export of artboards to PNG / JPEG / SVG / WebP
saving masters as .ai or PDF
walking every text frame or path for pre-press checks
fitting the artboard to a logo before export
rasterizing vector art in place
data-driven templates with variables and datasets
importing character / paragraph styles from a brand master file
avoid: changing width, height, rulerUnits or documentColorSpace here: they are read-only; resize through the artboard rect and pick units / colour mode when the document is created
close() with no argument on a modified document: it prompts and blocks an unattended run; pass SaveOptions.DONOTSAVECHANGES or SAVECHANGES
cropBox / cropStyle / pageOrigin for layout: legacy single-page settings; use artboards

equivalents.PS: Suite that applies to all applications/Document

cards.how: ExtendScript: app.activeDocument or app.documents[i]; new documents through the Documents collection. Every artwork collection hangs off it (doc.layers, doc.pathItems, doc.textFrames ...) and file output goes through saveAs / exportFile / exportForScreens. COM: the Document interface, where the export call is named Export rather than exportFile.

key_members.name: layers
key_members.use: the layer stack; add or find layers here

key_members.name: activeLayer
key_members.use: layer that new items go into

key_members.name: pageItems
key_members.use: all artwork of every type

key_members.name: pathItems
key_members.use: vector paths; also where new rectangles / ellipses are created

key_members.name: textFrames
key_members.use: all text frames

key_members.name: groupItems
key_members.use: groups (including outlined text)

key_members.name: placedItems
key_members.use: linked images and files (relink, embed, check links)

key_members.name: artboards
key_members.use: pages of the document; artboardRect sets their size and position

key_members.name: swatches
key_members.use: document swatches (brand colours)

key_members.name: characterStyles
key_members.use: named character styles

key_members.name: selection
key_members.use: current selection in this document

key_members.name: activeView
key_members.use: the window view (zoom / centre)

key_members.name: saveAs
key_members.use: save as .ai / .pdf / .eps / .fxg with the matching IllustratorSaveOptions / PDFSaveOptions / EPSSaveOptions / FXGSaveOptions; SVG goes through exportFile

key_members.name: exportFile
key_members.use: export to an ExportType (PNG24, JPEG, SVG, WEBP, AVIF ...) with matching options

key_members.name: exportForScreens
key_members.use: Export for Screens: artboards or assets to one ExportForScreensType per call (SE_PNG24, SE_JPEG80, SE_SVG, SE_PDF, SE_WEBP ...), with an optional file-name prefix

key_members.name: close
key_members.use: close, with SaveOptions to avoid the save prompt

key_members.name: rasterize
key_members.use: turn art into a raster item in place (source art is disposed)

key_members.name: imageCapture
key_members.use: write a raster image of a clip rectangle without changing the document

key_members.name: fitArtboardToSelectedArt
key_members.use: shrink-wrap an artboard to the selection

key_members.name: saved
key_members.use: dirty flag; true lets close() skip the prompt without writing the file

gotchas: Closing documents in a loop from index 0 skips every other one because app.documents shrinks; loop from the end.

saveAs / exportFile need a File object and an existing target folder, and the options object must match the format (e.g. ExportOptionsPNG24 with ExportType.PNG24); a mismatch fails with an unhelpful error (unverified wording).
rasterize disposes the source art (per the dictionary); keep a copy if the vector must survive.

Artwork created by script picks up the document defaults (defaultFilled, defaultFillColor, defaultStroked, defaultStrokeWidth ...) (unverified for every creation call); set them first or style each new item.
geometricBounds / visibleBounds cover all artwork, not the artboard; use artboards[i].artboardRect for the page size.
selection can be a TextRange rather than an array while text is being edited (unverified for 30.2).
documentColorSpace is read-only: RGB vs CMYK is decided when the document is created or opened.
exportForScreens builds its own file names and subfolders from the prefix and format (exact naming unverified); find the output on disk instead of assuming the name.
In a shared pipeline, only close or modify documents your script opened (compare fullName); others may belong to another process.

review.changes: saveAs listed .svg but the harvest has no SVG save options (only Illustrator/PDF/EPS/FXG); SVG is exportFile. exportForScreens takes a single ExportForScreensType, not several formats. Example fitted artboard 0 after selecting on the active artboard; now uses getActiveArtboardIndex

cards.name: CharacterAttributes
cards.path: Text processing commands and classes for Adobe Illustrator/CharacterAttributes
cards.summary: The character-level formatting of a range of text or of a character style: font, size, leading, tracking, kerning method, horizontal / vertical scale, baseline shift, rotation, caps, OpenType features, fill and stroke colour, underline / strike-through and language, plus the Japanese (wari-chu, tate-chu-yoko, aki, tsume) and Middle-Eastern (kashidas, digit set, diacritics) options.
use_for: setting headline font, size, leading and tracking from a brand spec
recolouring all text to a brand colour
all-caps or small-caps labels and buttons
OpenType ligatures, fractions, ordinals and stylistic sets for typographic polish
outlined-look lettering with strokeColor and strokeWeight
defining the look of a CharacterStyle
avoid: paragraph settings (justification, indents, space before / after): those live in ParagraphAttributes
repeating the same formatting on many frames: define it once in a CharacterStyle and applyTo

equivalents.PS: Scripting commands and classes for Adobe Photoshop/TextItem

cards.how: Never created directly: read characterAttributes from a TextRange (textFrame.textRange, story.textRange, or one item of the characters / words / paragraphs collections, e.g. tf.words[0]) or characterStyle.characterAttributes for a style definition. Story has no characterAttributes of its own. Setting a property applies it to every character in that range. COM: the CharacterAttributes interface.

key_members.name: textFont
key_members.use: the font, as a TextFont from app.textFonts

key_members.name: size
key_members.use: font size in points

key_members.name: autoLeading
key_members.use: automatic leading on / off

key_members.name: leading
key_members.use: line spacing in points (only with autoLeading off)

key_members.name: tracking
key_members.use: tracking in 1/1000 em (integer)

key_members.name: kerningMethod
key_members.use: AutoKernType NOAUTOKERN, AUTO, OPTICAL or METRICSROMANONLY

key_members.name: horizontalScale
key_members.use: horizontal glyph scale in percent (100 = normal)

key_members.name: verticalScale
key_members.use: vertical glyph scale in percent

key_members.name: baselineShift
key_members.use: raise / lower characters in points

key_members.name: rotation
key_members.use: rotate each character in degrees

key_members.name: capitalization
key_members.use: FontCapsOption NORMALCAPS, SMALLCAPS, ALLCAPS, ALLSMALLCAPS

key_members.name: fillColor
key_members.use: text colour (assign a Color object)

key_members.name: strokeColor
key_members.use: colour of the text stroke

key_members.name: strokeWeight
key_members.use: stroke width of the text

key_members.name: underline
key_members.use: underline on / off

key_members.name: strikeThrough
key_members.use: strike-through on / off

key_members.name: ligature
key_members.use: standard OpenType ligatures

key_members.name: fractions
key_members.use: OpenType fractions

key_members.name: stylisticSets
key_members.use: OpenType stylistic sets

key_members.name: language
key_members.use: language for hyphenation and spelling

gotchas: leading is ignored while autoLeading is true; set autoLeading = false before setting leading.
textFont takes a TextFont object (app.textFonts.getByName with the PostScript name), not a family-name string; a font that is not installed makes getByName throw.
fillColor / strokeColor hand back a copy: changing .red on it does not recolour the text (unverified for 30.2); build a Color object (RGBColor, CMYKColor, SpotColor ...) and assign it.
tracking is a whole number in 1/1000 em; horizontalScale / verticalScale are percentages (100 = normal), not factors.
Reading a property from a range with mixed formatting returns a single value without warning (unverified which run it comes from).
alignment is the character alignment of CJK text in its line (StyleRunAlignmentType), not paragraph left / centre / right.

The Japanese members (Tsume, wariChu*, tateChuYoko*, akiLeft / akiRight, kana, proportionalMetrics, italics, baselineDirection) and the Middle-Eastern ones (kashidas, dirOverride, digitSet, diacVPos / diacXOffset / diacYOffset) only show an effect with the matching composer and script.
stylisticSets is a single Int32 covering several sets (bit-field encoding unverified).
OpenType switches (fractions, ordinals, swash, titling ...) do nothing visible when the font lacks that feature.

review.changes: how implied a Story carries characterAttributes; Story has none in the harvest, so it now says story.textRange

cards.name: CharacterStyle
cards.path: Text processing commands and classes for Adobe Illustrator/CharacterStyle
cards.summary: A named character style from the Character Styles panel: a saved set of CharacterAttributes that is applied to text, so every piece of text using it updates when the style is edited.
use_for: brand typography systems (Headline, Price, Legal) applied the same way across a template
restyling every price in a catalogue by editing one style
giving words found by a script the same emphasis
importing a brand master's styles into working files (Document.importCharacterStyles)
avoid: paragraph formatting (justification, indents, spacing): use a ParagraphStyle
expecting applyTo to wipe hand formatting by default: pass clearingOverrides = true
cards.how: ExtendScript: app.activeDocument.characterStyles[i] or characterStyles.getByName("Headline"); a new style comes from the document collection, doc.characterStyles.add("Headline"). Define its look through style.characterAttributes, then call style.applyTo(textFrameOrTextRange, clearingOverrides). COM: the CharacterStyle interface.

key_members.name: name
key_members.use: style name as shown in the Character Styles panel (settable)

key_members.name: characterAttributes
key_members.use: the formatting the style stores; set its properties to define the style

key_members.name: applyTo
key_members.use: apply to a text frame or text range; second argument true clears local overrides

key_members.name: clear
key_members.use: remove all attributes from the style definition

key_members.name: add
key_members.use: listed on the class; in practice styles are created via doc.characterStyles.add(name)

key_members.name: remove
key_members.use: delete the style from the document

key_members.name: removeAll
key_members.use: listed on the class as Deletes all elements; what it does on a single style is unverified, use doc.characterStyles.removeAll() to clear the collection

key_members.name: parent
key_members.use: the owning Document

gotchas: The dictionary lists add() on this class with no parameters, but new styles are made through the document collection: doc.characterStyles.add(name).
applyTo(text, false) keeps local overrides, so hand-formatted text can look unchanged; pass true to make the text match the style exactly.
characterStyles[0] is the default [Normal Character Style]; whether it can be renamed or removed by script is unverified.
clear() empties the style's own attributes; it does not take the style off the text that uses it.
Only the attributes set on the style are imposed; the rest come from the paragraph style or local formatting of the text.
getByName on the collection needs the exact style name and throws when it is missing.
Removing a style that is applied to text: whether the text keeps its look as local formatting is unverified; re-apply a replacement style first.

review.changes: removeAll was described as delete all elements without saying it is an inherited collection method; now points at doc.characterStyles.removeAll() and marks the per-style effect unverified
